about: Tay is a township in Simcoe County, Ontario, on Georgian Bay east of Midland—not a city. Port McNicoll, Victoria Harbour, and Waubaushene sit among shoreline villages, rail heritage, and rural inland lots toward the Wye Marsh. About 10,000 people live in Tay Township.
